How to import data into R from different sources, including local files and online databases.
You will learn to not use local data files, but instead read the data from an online Google Sheets database

# 01 Setup your environment

Run the common setup script and synchronize the local project with
GitHub.

```{r}
# Run the setup script containing package restoration, helper functions, etc.
source(here::here("scripts", "01-setup.R"))

# Pull changes from the online repository into this local project folder.
# This is especially important when collaborating on the same project.
system2("git",c("-C", here::here(), "pull"))

# authenticate your @student.rug.nl google account
gsheets_auth()
```


# 02 Method 3 - read data from  online databases

This is the highly recommended choice of these three methods.
This means that there is only one version of
the data, and all collaborators read the same data. This is therefore
preferred method for collaborative projects, especially when the data change
 over time. The all team members always work with the up-to-date data.
